title: Cipher flyleaf in Speculum sophicum rhodo-stauroticum, SCH R 201 (DECODE R4817)

steps.what: Found Korn 2023 note 41 with Rous partial decipherment before attempting cipher. Targeted Tomokiyo searches returned no relevant result.
Retrieved e-manuscripta IIIF manifest and 2000px original flyleaf image 1033442. DECODE web extraction failed.
Visual distinction between triple-angle M and double-angle N suggests PRIMA MATERIA. Double cross in last line likely FF, yielding OFFEN. Testing all signs next.
Full-resolution image resolves the apparent UND as VOM: underlined small circle is O, triple angles M; triangle serves U/V. Thus ram gall, not gall and ram.
All five lines read with same substitution; literal GEFAE remains a likely scribal error for GEFAS, to be preserved separately from editorial correction.
Exact-phrase searches for ram gall / hemispherical vessel / furnace-scales found no independent text match.
Visually surveyed all 42 library canvases in contact sheets; no companion key or second specimen identified.
docs/_check_profile.py --measure transcription.txt: 79 tokens, 19 distinct; IC 0.0727. Deterministic replay assigns 79; ledger flags line 3 position 8 only.
All five lines read. VOM and OFFEN complete prior work; GEFAE remains literal, with Gefaess explicitly conjectural. 78/79 coherent without emendation.
Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 79 tokens, 19 types, de-1640s order 4: reading -2.144 per letter; Verdict: too short.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.144; polyphony 0.0; 0 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached n/a

outcome.method: key recovered based on plaintext from external sources
outcome.method_basis: Anne-Simone Rous's partial decipherment, published in Korn 2023 note 41 and found before the attack, was used as a crib; the substitution was completed and corrected against the original image (PRIMA MATERIA, VOM, OFFEN).
outcome.fraction_read_source: token_ledger.json: 79 cipher tokens assigned; one flagged anomaly at line 3 position 8 excluded from coherent fraction. Generated by decode.py from transcription.txt + key.json.
outcome.notes: Internal substitution consistency and German syntax; no independent plaintext or archive key. Rous partial reading used before attack. All occurring signs read; literal GEFAE preserved, Gefaess conjectural. Alchemical interpretation and annotation date/author remain unknown.
